name: Enter T4 Employment Income
description: Open StudioTax 2024 and create a new tax return for Jonah Smith. Read the scenario file at C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\TaxScenarios\scenario_jonah_smith.txt for all required data. Enter the following: (1) Personal information — name: Jonah Smith, SIN: 193-456-787, DOB: March 15, 1999, marital status: Single, province: Newfoundland and Labrador, address: 123 Main Street, St. John's, NL A1B 2C3. (2) Navigate to the T-Slips section and add a new T4 slip with the employment income data from Casey's Bakery — Box 14: $18,000.00 employment income, Box 16: $870.90 CPP contributions, Box 18: $284.40 EI premiums, Box 20: $675.00 RPP contributions, Box 22: $2,209.80 income tax deducted, Box 44: $235.25 union dues, Box 85: $76.50 private health plan premiums. (3) Save the completed return as 'jonah_smith.24t' in C:\Users\Docker\Documents\StudioTax.
